question: 2013 年平均每笔佣金是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(fact_trades.Commission) / COUNT(fact_trades.TradeID) AS average_commission_per_trade FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2013 LIMIT 100

fibo_concepts.note: 平均每笔佣金 = 佣金合计 / 成交笔数，以佣金费用度量（派生指标口径锚定）
